<thought>To construct a valid retrosynthetic route I need to find actual template IDs that apply to the target molecule. I will search the template catalog for a disconnection that breaks a carbon‑carbon double bond to give an aldehyde (a common Wittig/olefination disconnection) and another that breaks a carboxylic ester to give a carboxylic acid and an alcohol. These searches should return real template IDs that I can use in the final JSON route.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehydes"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
